description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Amending the notice published under the Exchange Control Act in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1681/10 of 22.11.2010
reasoning: This gazette notice contains an amendment to a schedule under the Exchange Control Act, which is a legal/regulatory matter. It involves the repeal of a specific item (security services) from the regulatory framework, making it a modification to existing financial regulations rather than a government personnel or structural change.
